Sword & Shield series · BRS

Brilliant Stars

Released February 25, 2022 · 186 cards

StandardExpanded

Brilliant Stars is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on February 25, 2022. Its main set has 172 cards, plus 14 secret rares numbered beyond the set (186 in total). It includes 151 Pokémon, 34 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

93 illustrators worked on Brilliant Stars. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (16), PLANETA Mochizuki (11), Ayaka Yoshida (4), N-DESIGN Inc. (4), AKIRA EGAWA (3), Eske Yoshinob (3), Hitoshi Ariga (3), HYOGONOSUKE (3).
